spec.structural_change: HBM-COLLECT10/QCORE 10-21 r15a (MAIN) = r13c RTL unchanged + floorplan fix after route hbm_su_qcore_r14a_1021-q14a-a6e06749c EARLY_FAIL_CONGESTION (GRT-0116, post-repair_design overflow 7: M2 1/M3 3/M4 3) and r14b gate GRT ovf 6: every marker sits in cap-0 gcells at the SRAM E pin face (x175.6-181.3; raw5_s/g_sec sector nets). Root cause: the kit's 10.8-um pin-face halo only reached MACRO_PLACE_HALO (rtl_macro_placer, unused with fixed placement); the tapcell row cut used the ASAP7 default MACRO_ROWS_HALO 2x2 (2_3_floorplan_tapcell.log 'Halo Around Macro : 2 2'), so std cells sat 2 um from 410 M4 pins per 41-um SRAM face (10 pins/um). Fix: MACRO_ROWS_HALO_X 21.6 / Y 5.4 (real cell-free pin-escape channel on both SRAM pin faces); outline widened 280.8 -> 302.4 (W/E tile pin ranges unchanged, N clk/rst re-centred +10.8) so the std-cell channels beside the pin-face halos stay >= 73 um (W) / 87 um (E); N stack at x97.2. Prior: HBM-QCORE9 10-20 r13 = r12 + (a) FP adders = Codex FP6 ot_hdc_fp32_add_n32 (d73bee5f7, standalone native max 32, bit-exact LAT6/DRST0) with its copy-alias + splitter canonicalize as this kit's SYNTH_CANONICALIZE_TCL (r12 residual: ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat cut bits 53-135, flattened FP roots <=129); (b) per-(bank,half) writer bank-hit compare (r12 hit_b 44-46); (c) reset landing 24 copies (r12 12 copies 69/48/35). Prior: HBM-QCORE8 10-20 r12 = r11 + kept one-hot select submodule per writer (r11 census: hits pushed into data, 52-78), reducer r12 replicated write data + 2 kept per-SRAM pd mask copies (8 x 96), reset landing last stage x12 copies (rst 281 loads). Prior: HBM-QCORE8 10-20 r11 = r10 + DRIVER copies (r10 gate census max 273: loads count through kept hierarchy): sector bank-hit predecode once per writer + row/COLL fields in 2 kept copies; pretree per-node-byte kept mode/valid copies + per-byte comparators. Residual expected: ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat internals only. Prior: HBM-QCORE8 10-20 r10 = r9 + native-32 fixes (main gate now REFUSES at floorplan on native census: r6n max 512, r9 max 437): per (bank, 16-bit half) kept writer modules (r9 sector decode 437 loads), rc_x source one-hot in 4 kept per-byte copies (e_sl 128), pretree_j_r10 per-byte kept operand selects (t_p mode 350 / valid 165 / node mode 211), reducer r10 kept per-half write-data select (35). Same ports/edges/function. Residual expected: ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat internal cut-register fanouts (shared closed FP primitive). Prior: HBM-QCORE8 10-20 PARALLEL FALLBACK of r6n: Codex qcore r9 RTL (codex/hbm-qcore7-native32-1020 @779bb7be3, merged): same ports/edges/function as r5/r6n; read selects split into kept 2-bit one-hot groups (actual native read 3072 roots max 16 vs r6n 512), reset 35 roots max 32, reducer r32 word roots max 16; writer-side native still FAIL 634 roots/max 437 (sector COLL valid+decode) -- guidance under the 10-20 09:35 rule freeze, route timing decides. Same outline/pins/macros/floorplan as r6n (gate WARN, GRT 0, spread 25.9/23.0). Prior: r6 RTL (sector-local storage + gated reads, kept copies) placed by the placer without INCLUSIVE regions (the region groups crashed DPL); reset landed 2 stages. HBM-SU3 10-17 qcore r5 (coordinator 0dc): ot_hbm_su_static_qcore_r5 replaces the 66-root qcore (64 per-bank clk_rf + ctl + red; codex hbm_qcore_s_pinrung_r2, 76k FF on 330.48^2). One RF copy (8,192 flops) instead of six per-reader replicas, and only the selected word per read class is registered (raw k+1, rd k+2) instead of a raw/read_data register per (bank, reader) + bank-select mux: ~11.5k flops, ONE root clk_ctl (reducer SRAMs on it; g1 gate: clk_red reached SRAM clock pins, CTS refused a separate root). Read: per-sector word at k+1 from a per-sector address copy, sector select at k+2 (g1: 8,192-load address nets). Pins first (raw command/writer capture at k, decode after the flop). Same edges: commit k+1, rf_bword/rf_dsec k+3, scalar E+11; write-conflict FAULT +1 edge; invalid-read output words are don't-care (documented). Reducer SRAMs stacked on the 43.2 lattice; die faces kept (W slice, E channel, N clocks). Re-home: H-DIE-R7b/R8b grants put sucore_<q> beside its pgslices. g3 (HBM-SU6 10-17, g2 gate: rf_bcmd[*] 8,193 loads = synthesis merged the per-sector read-address copies with the rf_bcmd output flop; placement reg->reg -178.7 ps into mem D): every replicated pin-rung copy is a kept instance (keep_hierarchy ot_hbm_su_qcore_r5_kq): read address per (sector, class, 16-bit half), class 5 per (word slot, half), writer wv/wa/wd/rrv/rra per sector (8 banks each). Same edges; slice_x stays raw (a pin flop would move the E+1 operand edge). r6 (HH-11 10-19, route r5-1a1108053 NEEDS_RTL TT -314.4 / FF +11.49 / DRC 0, 6,633 TT-violating D: g_sec.u_wd -> mem D 20 levels (per-sector writer copies clumped at the E face, each sector's banks spread over the tile), class-5 r5a -> raw5 ~470 ps of placement buffers (slot kk read bank kk of all 8 sectors), cmd_p -> fault 18 levels; and route.period_ps 1111.111 made repair target 1111 instead of the 833 sign-off -> removed): one keep_hierarchy module per sector (ot_hbm_su_qcore_r6_sec: 8 banks x 4 rows x 32 b, raw writer copies incl. its own 256-b COLL data copy, one-hot priority write decode, read-address copies per (class, half), k+1 read registers GATED by the sector match), each placed as an INCLUSIVE region (sector_regions.tcl: 2 sectors per free band row, S/middle/N bands beside the SRAM rows); k+2 = OR of the 8 gated sector words (classes 0-4 and the class-5 row); write-conflict fault registered per sector (+1 edge, status only). Same ports + PRETREE 1 (HH-6: slice_t[267:0] on the W face beside slice_x, pretree_j beside the reducer), same edges (commit k+1, reads k+3, E+11, tree operand E+69).
